title: Graphics.
officialText: The height of letters shall be not less than 6 inches (152 mm), except that in Group A and Group R- 1 occupancies letters shall be not less than 8 inches (203 mm) high. Graphics shall have letter widths, strokes and spacing in proportion to their height.
